# Ibn Sina Hospital

> Ibn Sina Hospital is a multi-specialty hospital in Budgam, Jammu & Kashmir, offering 24/7 OPD, emergency, pharmacy, laboratory, dialysis, endoscopy, TMT, Holter monitoring, ABPM, digital X-ray, and consultant-led care across 20+ specialties.

## Key Details

- **Name:** Ibn Sina Hospital
- **Address:** Near Railway Station, Ompora Railway Station Road, Ompora, Budgam, Jammu & Kashmir 191111, India
- **Phone:** +91 9622552553 / +91 9419023501
- **Email:** weibnsina@gmail.com
- **Hours:** OPD, Pharmacy, Lab & Emergency — 24/7, 365 days
- **Website:** https://ibnsinahospital.in/

## Services

- 24/7 Emergency & Ambulance
- 24/7 Pharmacy
- 24/7 Diagnostic Lab
- Dialysis (in-house)
- Endoscopy & Colonoscopy
- TMT (Treadmill Test)
- Holter Monitoring
- ABPM (Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring)
- Digital X-Ray & Ultrasound
- Physiotherapy
- Sigmoidoscopy
- Vaccinations
- PM-JAY cashless treatment for eligible patients
